forwarding_route.rule: ForwardingMode = bridge address 0 != 255; ForwardingRoute tests and appends each of six bridge entries independently, retaining later non-255 entries after a gap. When ForwardingMode is set it prefixes GetDepthAndCountByte 0x1258f08 = depth + depth * 8, where depth is the first unused bridge index + 1. With all six entries non-255 this routine leaves depth zero; initial attribute-string buffer lifecycle remains unverified. See wireless-connection-source-review.json for the corrected source proof and bounded editor.
forwarding_route.editor: The separate wireless_connection editor resolves one-to-five extra-network routes from frozen topology; arbitrary stored tails and full original parent save remain outside that subset.
